context.description: Infrastructure unblock: zig build test-env-verify exited 1. Fix services and schema so test-env-verify exits 0.

task.description:
The bench env check failed (zig build test-env-verify exit 1). Diagnose and fix:

1. Run python tools/verify_test_env.py directly to see which checks fail and their error messages.
2. Start required services: docker-compose up -d db db_test keycloak
3. Wait until services are healthy: docker-compose ps
4. If schema drift: run zig build migrate (using BPM_TEST_DB_URL)
5. If orphan tenant rows: run clean_test_db.py or the manual Docker exec form that was used before
6. Re-run zig build test-env-verify until exit 0
7. Return PASS only when zig build test-env-verify exits 0

result.summary: zig build test-env-verify exits 0. Root cause: migration 1154_idn05_tenant_role_registry.sql lacked a '-- scope: tenant_only' header, so migrate.zig attempted to run its FK-bearing DDL against the public schema where 'groups' table does not exist, producing error.ServerError. Fix: (1) added '-- scope: tenant_only' to the migration file; (2) updated src/tools/migrate.zig to import migrationScope/MigrationScope from db_provisioning and skip SQL execution for tenant_only migrations while still recording a ledger entry (consistent with the pattern established by migrations 026/093/095). All 10 verify_test_env checks now pass (C3: 136/136 applied, C4: ledger matches).
result.next_action: Environment healthy — integration tests can now proceed
